sources.title: Center-stabilized Yang-Mills theory: confinement and large N volume independence
sources.extraction: pdftotext -layout; exact PDF numbering used, which differs from arXiv HTML numbering
checks_performed: arXiv abstract version history and HTML banner authenticate v2, 22 March 2008
Downloaded exact v2 PDF and checked its title/banner and formulas
Read roots, kinetic normalization, signed gas weights, one-loop prefactor and theta insertion
Rendered physical PDF pages 19, 20 and 27 at 1500px and visually confirmed the factor-two discrepancy, imaginary-theta typo and appendix deformation sign in the actual equation pixels
Directly expanded the four signed event vertices; did not inherit inconsistent fugacity factors
formula_issues: Printed gas equation (3.22) assigns zeta to each signed event, so its expansion gives -2 zeta sum cos; printed dual equation (3.25) instead has -zeta sum cos. Define f by the signed-event measure and derive the coefficient, rather than assigning both displayed zeta symbols the same numerical normalization.
Equation (3.29) prints i theta/N inside cosine despite text stating phase weights exp(+/- i theta/N), and equation (3.30) having real theta. Derive the real cosine argument from the event phases.

Appendix (A.6) and the main fugacity formula differ in printed deformation-sign presentation; use positive suppression exp(-Delta S) from main equation (3.23), with f retained as independently matched rather than evaluated numerically.
No use is made of the source's quoted Fourier mass eigenvalues; the SU2 Hessian is derived from the explicitly fixed scalar action.
sources.application_verdict: verified input action and parametric flat-space signed-event fugacity, with explicit normalization repair; curved S3 matching not supplied by this flat-space source

sources.role: Prior ball-boundary result only. It is not reused as a closed-sphere fugacity or determinant.
